title: Add Parallel Responses adapter as a native grounding family
description: Implement the Parallel Responses adapter as a native grounding family, DISABLED BY DEFAULT behind an explicit opt-in gate (e.g. PI_SEARCH_ENABLE_PARALLEL_RESPONSES=1 or a dedicated credential var) — never automatic, never selected by provider: native. It rides the existing native grounding infrastructure: executeGroundedSearch in src/grounding.ts + one NATIVE_REGISTRY row in src/router.ts + capabilities/build/normalize + offline fixtures, same shape as Meta. Open questions to resolve at implementation: (1) billing/routing policy — metered per reasoning effort ($10 low/$50 medium/$250 high per 1K), so opt-in gate required and reasoning-effort mapping decision (contracts have no effort control today; options: hardcode a tier, map answerMode, or add a new option); (2) credential mechanism — confirm the Responses endpoint accepts PARALLEL_API_KEY (x-api-key) or needs a separate var; (3) live contract smoke with the existing key per docs/live-smoke.md. User direction 2026-09-06: not enabled by default because agent-side synthesis from cheap evidence search + web_fetch covers current workflows; the adapter is still worth having as an opt-in capability. Quality evidence: Parallel advanced ranks #1 of 12 on independent Artificial Analysis Search Index (Aug 2026); recorded in docs/provider-policy.md.

logs.msg: Created from 2026-09-06 provider round: user declined implementation now, wants the option tracked. Do not start without explicit user direction; resolve the four open questions first.

Declined 2026-09-06: provider-synthesized answers are redundant for this extension. The calling agent already has cheap evidence search (native grounding + Exa/Brave/Parallel) plus web_fetch, and can synthesize its own answers from inspectable evidence at model cost. Parallel Responses is metered per reasoning effort (0-250/1K) for output the agent produces better from raw evidence. Task closed as declined; do not reopen without a workflow that genuinely needs provider-side synthesis.

Reopened same day: prior 'declined' close was too absolute. Correct position: viable opt-in capability, disabled by default, gated explicitly — not enabled-by-default because agent-side synthesis from cheap evidence search + web_fetch covers current workflows.
